verses.original: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος Ἐκλεκτῇ κυρίᾳ καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτῆς οὓς ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος ἀλλὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐγνωκότες τὴν ἀλήθειαν
verses.transliteration: Ho presbyteros Eklektē kyria kai tois teknois autēs hous egō agapō en alētheia kai ouk egō monos alla kai pantes hoi egnōkotes tēn alētheian
verses.literal: The elder To the chosen lady and her children whom I love in the truth and not I alone but also all who know the truth
verses.literalPt: O presbítero, à senhora eleita com seus filhos, aos quais eu amo em verdade; e não somente eu, mas também todos aqueles que conhecem a verdade,

verses.original: διὰ τὴν ἀλήθειαν τὴν μένουσαν ἐν ἡμῖν καὶ μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἔσται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: dia tēn alētheian tēn menousan en hēmin kai meth’ hēmōn estai eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever
verses.literalPt: por amor da verdade que permanece em nós e será conosco para sempre,

verses.original: Ἔσται μεθ’ ἡμῶν χάρις ἔλεος εἰρήνη παρὰ Θεοῦ Πατρός καὶ παρὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Πατρός ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: Estai meth’ hēmōn charis eleos eirēnē para Theou Patros kai para Iēsou Christou tou Huiou tou Patros en alētheia kai agapē
verses.literal: Grace mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ the Son of the Father will be with us in truth and love
verses.literalPt: a graça, a misericórdia e a paz, da parte de Deus Pai, e da de Jesus Cristo, Filho do Pai, serão conosco em verdade e amor.

verses.original: Ἐχάρην λίαν ὅτι εὕρηκα ἐκ τῶν τέκνων σου περιπατοῦντας ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καθὼς ἐντολὴν ἐλάβομεν παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός
verses.transliteration: Echarēn lian hoti heurēka ek tōn teknōn sou peripatountas en alētheia kathōs entolēn elabomen para tou Patros
verses.literal: I was overjoyed . . . to find some of your children walking in the truth just as the Father has commanded us
verses.literalPt: Folgo muito em ter achado alguns de teus filhos andando em verdade, conforme o mandamento que recebemos do Pai.

verses.original: καὶ νῦν ἐρωτῶ σε κυρία οὐχ ὡς ἐντολὴν γράφων σοι καινὴν ἀλλὰ ἣν εἴχομεν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἵνα ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: kai nyn erōtō se kyria ouch hōs entolēn graphōn soi kainēn alla hēn eichomen ap’ archēs hina agapōmen allēlous
verses.literal: And now I urge you dear lady not as a new commandment to you but one we have had from the beginning that we love one another
verses.literalPt: Agora, te rogo, senhora, não como te escrevendo um novo mandamento, mas o mesmo que temos tido desde o princípio, que nos amemos uns aos outros.

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη ἵνα περιπατῶμεν κατὰ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ αὕτη ἡ ἐντολή ἐστιν καθὼς ἠκούσατε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἵνα ἐν αὐτῇ περιπατῆτε
verses.transliteration: kai hautē estin hē agapē hina peripatōmen kata tas entolas autou hautē hē entolē estin kathōs ēkousate ap’ archēs hina en autē peripatēte
verses.literal: And this is love that we walk according to His commandments This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning that you must walk in love
verses.literalPt: Esse amor consiste em andarmos segundo os seus mandamentos; e esse mandamento consiste, conforme ouvistes desde o princípio, em andardes neste amor.

verses.original: Ὅτι πολλοὶ πλάνοι ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸν κόσμον οἱ μὴ ὁμολογοῦντες Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐρχόμενον ἐν σαρκί οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ πλάνος καὶ ὁ ἀντίχριστος
verses.transliteration: Hoti polloi planoi exēlthon eis ton kosmon hoi mē homologountes Iēsoun Christon erchomenon en sarki houtos estin ho planos kai ho antichristos
verses.literal: For many deceivers have gone out into the world refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist
verses.literalPt: Pois muitos sedutores têm aparecido no mundo, os quais não confessam que Jesus Cristo veio em carne; esse tal é o sedutor e o anticristo.

verses.original: βλέπετε ἑαυτούς ἵνα μὴ ἀπολέσητε ἃ εἰργασάμεθα ἀλλὰ μισθὸν πλήρη ἀπολάβητε
verses.transliteration: blepete heautous hina mē apolesēte ha eirgasametha alla misthon plērē apolabēte
verses.literal: Watch yourselves so that you do not lose what we have worked for but that you may be fully rewarded . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Acautelai-vos, para que não percais o nosso trabalho, mas recebais pleno galardão.

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ προάγων καὶ μὴ μένων ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Θεὸν οὐκ ἔχει ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ οὗτος καὶ τὸν Πατέρα καὶ τὸν Υἱὸν ἔχει
verses.transliteration: pas ho proagōn kai mē menōn en tē didachē tou Christou Theon ouk echei ho menōn en tē didachē houtos kai ton Patera kai ton Huion echei
verses.literal: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son
verses.literalPt: Todo o que vai além do ensino de Cristo e não permanece nele não tem a Deus; o que permanece nesse ensino tem tanto ao Pai como ao Filho.

verses.original: Εἴ τις ἔρχεται πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ταύτην τὴν διδαχὴν οὐ φέρει μὴ λαμβάνετε αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκίαν καὶ χαίρειν αὐτῷ μὴ λέγετε
verses.transliteration: Ei tis erchetai pros hymas kai tautēn tēn didachēn ou pherei mē lambanete auton eis oikian kai chairein autō mē legete
verses.literal: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching do not receive him into your home or even greet . . . him
verses.literalPt: Se alguém vem ter convosco e não traz este ensino, não o recebais em casa, nem o saudeis;

verses.original: ὁ λέγων γὰρ αὐτῷ χαίρειν κοινωνεῖ τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ τοῖς πονηροῖς
verses.transliteration: ho legōn gar autō chairein koinōnei tois ergois autou tois ponērois
verses.literal: Whoever greets . . . such a person shares in his evil deeds
verses.literalPt: porque aquele que o saúda participa de suas más obras.

verses.original: Πολλὰ ἔχων ὑμῖν γράφειν οὐκ ἐβουλήθην διὰ χάρτου καὶ μέλανος ἀλλὰ ἐλπίζω γενέσθαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ στόμα πρὸς στόμα λαλῆσαι ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡμῶν πεπληρωμένη ᾖ
verses.transliteration: Polla echōn hymin graphein ouk eboulēthēn dia chartou kai melanos alla elpizō genesthai pros hymas kai stoma pros stoma lalēsai hina hē chara hēmōn peplērōmenē ē
verses.literal: I have many things to write to you but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink Instead I hope to come and speak with you face to face so that our joy may be complete
verses.literalPt: Embora tenha muitas coisas para vos escrever, não o quero fazer com papel e tinta, mas espero ir visitar-vos e falar-vos face a face, para que o nosso gozo seja completo.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεταί σε τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἀδελφῆς σου τῆς ἐκλεκτῆς
verses.transliteration: Aspazetai se ta tekna tēs adelphēs sou tēs eklektēs
verses.literal: The children of your elect sister send you greetings . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de tua irmã eleita te saúdam.
